verses.tl: Maa dalla saahibukum wa maa ghawaa
In hiya illaa asmaa'un sammaytumoohaa antum wa aabaa'uukum maa anzala Allaahu bihaa min sultaanin in yattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa maa tahwal-anfusu wa laqad jaa'ahum min rabbihimul-hudaa
Wa kam min malakin fis-samaawaati laa tughnee shafaa'atuhum shay'an illaa min ba'di an ya'dhana Allaahu liman yashaa'u wa yardaa
Innal-ladheena laa yu'minoona bil-aakhirati layusammoonal-malaa'ikata tasmiyatal-unthaa
Wa maa lahum bihi min ilmin in yattabi'oona illaz-zanna wa innaz-zanna laa yughnee minal-haqqi shay'aa
Fa-a'rid an man tawallaa an dhikrinaa wa lam yurid illal-hayaatad-dunyaa
Dhaalika mablaghuhum minal-ilmi inna rabbaka huwa a'lamu biman dalla an sabeelihi wa huwa a'lamu bimani ihtadaa
Wa Lillaahi maa fis-samaawaati wa maa fil-ardi liyajziyal-ladheena asaa'oo bimaa amiloo wa yajziyal-ladheena ahsanoo bil-husnaa

Al-ladheena yajtaniboona kabaa'iral-ithmi wal-fawaahisha illal-lamama inna rabbaka waasi'ul-maghfirati huwa a'lamu bikum idh ansha'akum minal-ardi wa idh antum ajinnatun fee butooni ummahaatikum falaa tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa a'lamu bimani ittaqaa
Am lam yunabba bimaa fee suhufi moosaa
Wa an laysa lil-insaani illaa maa sa'aa
Wa annahu huwa adhaka wa abkaa
Wa annahu huwa amaata wa ahyaa
Wa annahu huwa aghnaa wa aqnaa
Wa qawma noohin min qablu innahum kaanoo hum azlama wa atghaa
